meta.name: Tooth Pari When Love Bites
meta.description: A rebellious vampire with a broken tooth falls for a shy dentist on the streets of Kolkata but will human and mystical forces keep them apart?

videos.title: Upar Neeche
videos.overview: After breaking a tooth while hunting for blood, Rumi crosses paths with Roy, a timid dentist. Kartik, an outcast cop, looks into a mysterious case.

videos.title: The Cutmundus
videos.overview: Roy's rare blood sparks interest from Rumi's clan, as Sreela is sent after him. Kartik’s case sends a signal to a secret cabal of vampire hunters.

videos.title: Climate Change
videos.overview: When a vampire is killed, an awakened Ora bans access to the human world above ground. Hell-bent on revenge, Rumi seeks help from an unlikely source.

videos.title: The Test
videos.overview: Badshah is taken underground. Kartik learns about his father's past from Luna Luka. At a family dinner, Roy grows suspicious over Rumi's true nature.

videos.title: Darinda
videos.overview: Roy struggles with his feelings for Rumi. The Cutmundus plot to uncover the vampires' secrets, while Rumi ponders grief, love and loss of her past.

videos.title: Tyajet Kularthe Purusham
videos.overview: The death of a Cutmundus member leads Luna down a vengeful path. Believing that Roy is a vampire, a desperate Kartik resorts to blackmail.

videos.title: Meet the Parents
videos.overview: Dinner at the Roy's turns into a night of drunken revelry, while Rumi and Roy take an intimate step. Later, Badshah's revelation puts Rumi in danger.

videos.title: No. 30
videos.overview: Rumi is faced with a devastating ultimatum — go after Luna, or lose Roy forever. A figure from Luna's past returns to her life.
